review: The Middle Apprentice Ishmael (Shortened to Middle Ishmael from now on) makes for a solid side grade to Middle Sinclair, even outperforming him in some cases. Middle Ishmael, like all other Middle units, emphasizes Envy Resonance to gain massive amounts of Offense Level while also gaining access to her S3 through her counter when there is 6+ Envy A-Resonance. Going over Middle Ishmael’s passive first, she has three unique effects that will be elaborated upon later as they become relevant: - Firstly, we’ll go over “The Middle - Grudge”: Every time an enemy hits Middle Ishmael, she will gain 2 “The Middle - Grudge” up to 2 times per turn. When another ally who has the tag “The Middle” is hit by an enemy, she will gain 1 “The Middle - Grudge” once per turn per Identity. Additionally, if the target that attacked the enemy has Vengeance Mark, Middle Ishmael will gain 1 more “The Middle - Grud
